name: release-safety
description: Provider-neutral release safety: prove a fix is deployed to the target environment (not just merged) by reconciling the running commit SHA, diff env secrets by name before promotion, check that a tag matches the manifest, CHANGELOG and earlier tags, keep CI gates and tag ordering honest, and run risky migrations through a backup, stage, additive-then-cutover skeleton. Hooks remind Claude about release ordering; an opt-in ask mode makes you confirm tag pushes and releases.

guard_mode.title: Release push guard mode
guard_mode.description: advise (default): remind Claude after a tag push, branch-plus-tag push, gh release create or remote tag delete. ask: you confirm these before they run. off: no guard. RELEASE_SAFETY_MODE overrides this.

session_hint.title: Session start reminder
session_hint.description: Show one release-safety reminder per project, only in projects with CI or deploy configuration.
